cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's really good to see you, Tom.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Since I had to give up work, I feel I'm losing touch with my friends and colleagues.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: We really miss you in the office. We were all so sorry you had to leave.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: But you must be relieved to have more time to look after your mother. How is she?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well she is very cheerful, but she needs a lot of help.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Have you tried to get any support from the local council?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, they offer different kinds of practical support.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: They realise that carers sometimes need time for all the other responsibilities they

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: have, apart from the person they're caring for, and also that they sometimes need a break.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Absolutely. OK, so tell me more. How do I go about getting this support?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, you'd have to have an assessment of your mother's needs.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That means someone would come round and talk to you about the situation and what you need.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: So, for a start, they'd want to know the amount of time you spend looking after your

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: mother every day.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Then they'll probably ask you what sorts of tasks you do for your mother during the day.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Things like if she needs help with getting dressed, for example.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Right. I help her with that. And also I help her get into the shower in the morning.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, that sort of thing.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: They'll probably ask you if you do the shopping for her and help her at mealtimes, and

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: whether she can cope using money.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, that's becoming a bit of a problem. She used to be very good at it, but not anymore.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And be ready to tell them about anything you find particularly difficult about caring for

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: your mother.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: So, recently I've noticed she's started to have quite bad problems with her memory.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: If I wasn't there, I think she'd forget to eat, for example.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And often she doesn't seem quite sure what day it is.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, tell them about that.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And are there any physical difficulties you have caring for her? Lifting her, for example?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, she's quite heavy and I'm afraid of hurting my back.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I'd be in real trouble if that happened.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: They can give you advice about that and also about how to avoid the possibility of your

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: mum having a fall.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Great. So once they've done this assessment, if I'm eligible, what happens next?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, they might support you financially.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: So they might help you with transport costs, like if you have to get a taxi to take your

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: mother for an appointment, for example.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I usually drive her myself, actually. So, could I claim the petrol?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: You could. And you can claim for the insurance too.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And if you need help with the housework, they can arrange for someone to come along once

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: or twice a week. And one other thing.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I hope you don't mind me saying this, but it's important you look after yourself.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And it seems to me you're under quite a bit of stress.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well tell the council because they may be able to give you some advice on how to minimise

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: it.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Really? Though, actually, I feel so much better having talked to you.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I'll get in touch with the council straight away.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Now, shall we go for coffee or something?
